description: Test suite for hiredis Redis client library, including connection handling, command formatting, reply parsing, and error handling.

methods.name: select_database
methods.description: Switches Redis connection to database 9 and verifies it's empty.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects Redis context, optionally keeping the file descriptor.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes Redis connection based on configuration (TCP, UNIX socket, or inherited fd).

methods.name: test_format_commands
methods.description: Tests Redis command formatting functions with various inputs.

methods.name: test_append_formatted_commands
methods.description: Tests appending formatted commands to Redis connection.

methods.name: test_reply_reader
methods.description: Tests Redis reply parser's error handling, memory management, and edge cases.

methods.name: test_free_null
methods.description: Ensures redisFree and freeReplyObject handle NULL inputs gracefully.

methods.name: test_blocking_connection_errors
methods.description: Tests error handling for connection failures.

methods.name: test_blocking_connection
methods.description: Tests basic command execution over a blocking Redis connection.

methods.name: test_blocking_connection_timeouts
methods.description: Tests command timeouts and reconnection logic.

methods.name: test_blocking_io_errors
methods.description: Tests I/O error handling during command execution.

methods.name: test_invalid_timeout_errors
methods.description: Tests error handling for invalid timeout configurations.
